name: handstand walk
description: An advanced bodyweight skill where you walk on your hands while inverted. It builds shoulder strength, balance and body control.
instructions: Kick up into a handstand against a wall or with a spotter, hands shoulder-width apart.
Squeeze your glutes and legs together and push tall through your shoulders.
Shift your weight onto one hand and move the other forward a small step.
Alternate hands in short, controlled steps, keeping your core tight.
Come down safely with control, and practise on soft ground.
